title: Oral Health Education for Caregivers of Children With Disabilities
brief_summary: Considering the impact of caregivers' oral health knowledge, attitudes and practices on the oral health of their children; we introduced an educational program to the parents and caregivers of children with developmental disabilities about the oral healthcare of their developmentally disabled children to rise up with the oral health status of those children.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* has a developmental disability.
* enrolled in any of the randomly selected special education schools.
* caregivers signed the informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* not a student in any of the randomly selected special education schools.
* caregivers refused to participate and sign the informed consent.
* age not in the range of 3 - 18 years old.
